value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by PG&E across its entire distribution territory, which includes Tracy/San Joaquin County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other PG&E-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Completed Building Permit Application (new submittals) or Resubmittal/Revision Form
All plans (drawings) combined into one PDF, 11"x17" format, properly sorted and oriented
Specification sheets for modules, inverters, optimizers, micro-inverters, RSS relays, combiner boxes, disconnects, racking systems, roof stand-offs, flashings, and sealants
Scaled site plan (min. 1/8"=1') with roof plan view showing access points, setbacks, pathways, vents, fireplaces, and furnace/water heater vents
Single-line electrical diagram (strings/modules per string, combiner boxes, conductor/conduit type and size, inverter model, load centers)
Main service panel rating, busbar rating, and backfed breaker overcurrent protection rating
Conductor ampacity calculations, complete labeling schedule, bonding/grounding lug type, manufacturer listing information, and clear interior photos of the electrical service panel
